# REAMIMA

> Engineering and R&D company (Ingeniería, I+D+i) based in Spain. One that treats complexity as an advantage, not an obstacle. One of the few that chooses the hard way when the easy way exists.

REAMIMA TECH, S.L. designs and builds what conventional engineering considers out of reach. Capabilities span the full stack: hardware, electronics, full industrial automation (sensor, network, PLC/Simatic, SCADA, MES), real-time control, high-performance software and product design. On-device processing — no servers, no cloud, privacy as system architecture. Open hardware when it matters (OSHWA certified). What seems impossible to run — simply works.

Company: REAMIMA TECH, S.L. (Spanish limited liability company)
General contact: info@reamima.com
Web contact form: https://reamima.com/contacta.html

## Projects

- [Cardistream](https://cardistream.com): Physical performance optimisation software. Long-term athlete tracking — day by day, month by month, year by year.
- [Isostream](https://reamima.com/sobre.html): Hardware product with industrial-grade design and embedded electronics.

## Origins — Emergency Ventilator (2020)

During the first weeks of the COVID-19 lockdown, REAMIMA designed an open-hardware emergency ventilator using off-the-shelf materials — no compressed-air line required. OSHWA certified. Engineering without manufacturing or ordering parts: with what was on the shelf. A crisis does not create capabilities. It reveals them.

- [Origins](https://reamima.com/origenes.html): The full project story, recognitions and the three ventilator models.
- [Simple Model](https://reamima.com/origenes-simple.html): Base ventilator — aquarium pump, water columns, microcontroller.
- [Advanced Model](https://reamima.com/origenes-avanzado.html): Pressure control, assisted expiration, inline sensors (Bosch BME family), clinical monitoring. Siemens Simatic S7-1500 H redundancy reference for critical environments.
- [Air Treatment](https://reamima.com/origenes-tratamiento-aire.html): UV sterilisation, heating and humidity conditioning of the air supply.
